points.description: Labels the training data with positive/negative class labels and initializes the weight vector (e.g. randomly or to zeros/fixed values).

levels.says: Both labeling the data with +/- labels and initializing the weights are present.
Only one of labeling the data or initializing the weights is present.

points.description: Gives the perceptron update rule: for each training example, if <w,x> <= 0 (or equivalently y<w,x> <= 0 with signed labels), update w <- w + eta*x (or w <- w + eta*y*x); otherwise leave w unchanged.

levels.says: Mentions an update using eta and x/y but omits or misstates the misclassification condition, or states the condition but not the update.

points.description: Repeats the update over all training examples/epochs until the weights stop changing much / convergence, and notes that convergence is guaranteed because the data are linearly separable.

levels.says: Both an iterative stopping/convergence condition and the convergence guarantee for linearly separable data are present.
Only the iterative stopping/convergence condition or only the convergence guarantee is present.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a recognizable perceptron training loop: labels, initialization, the conditional update, and repetition until convergence. Award part marks for missing components as specified. No marks for an answer that gives no perceptron update or no iterative training.
